title: The Danger Grid
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: finished premium graphic-novel team illustration for the ARC Daily Digest and its ARC MUTANTS card collection. NEW EPISODE inspired by the X-Men gifted-hero academy lore the editor requested, continuing the established ARC Mutants quartet. Exactly FOUR adult male hero characters, no other people, no animals. Input1 is the APPROVED team image and locks the four identities, technology, graphic-novel rendering and costume continuity. Input2 is Jack's individual character identity: use his face, distinctive central circuit-board headset and cyan visor ONLY, ignore ALL old text and historical statistics. Input3 is Mark's own bearded cyber-engineer avatar, GPU headgear and cabling. Input4 is Son's own younger Asian face, broad luminous visor and black GPU headgear. Preserve recognizable lower faces and all established character identities; do not substitute actors or random superhero faces. JACK COLE: composed cerebral mentor in the Professor Charles Xavier role, central in a sleek hovering command chair, tailored navy academy coat, his recognizable cyan visor and circuit headset; intelligence and calm authority. MARK BARNEY: rugged bearded GPU-powered brawler with heavy asymmetrical teal/amber armor, enormous exposed graphics-card rig and short glowing circuit-prong gauntlets, broad confident silhouette. SON PHAM: agile precision energy specialist with his own broad visor and streamlined dark armor; focused cyan geometric energy, youthful friendly lower face. RONEN: tall ORIGINAL opaque-helmet grid-shield architect with violet-edged helmet and a shield of multicolored square cells; his face remains concealed. Detailed hand-inked cyberpunk graphic-novel art, rich graphic shapes, sophisticated readable hardware, cyan/teal with controlled amber and magenta light, tactile surfaces, spectacular colorful ARC input/output puzzle grids. Show all FOUR characters distinctly and give each a clear narrative action. No captions, lettering, words, title, logos, names, digits, ranks, scores, medals, watermarks, trading-card borders or old ARC Raiders branding. No snow, turkey vehicle or ARC3 crew. This is the separate FOUR-person ARC2 team. Wide cinematic 16:9 full-bleed image. Scene: THE DANGER GRID. A huge subterranean academy training chamber with moving geometric walls, bronze mechanical rings and a floor made of colorful square puzzle cells. Dynamic low camera and diagonal composition, an energetic training exercise captured at its most thrilling instant. Jack's hovering chair occupies the central midground, his outstretched hand calmly rotating a vast complex ARC-grid construct above the floor. Mark at left foreground braces and slashes a descending geometric barrier with his glowing circuit-prong gauntlet; no violence or injury. Son at right foreground leaps between illuminated square platforms and aims a sharply defined cyan beam to connect matching colored patterns. Ronen behind/right anchors a large translucent violet square-grid shield, rerouting flying colored tiles safely around the team. Every face and helmet readable, no body hidden behind another. Dramatic warm machinery light from below and cold cyan arcs overhead, elegant motion trails, strong depth, enormous sense of kinetic team coordination. Clearly a new location, action and camera rather than another static academy poster.
